title: Coconut wax jasmine candle
subtitle: A slow-burning floral jar candle
excerpt: A coconut wax jar candle scented with jasmine fragrance oil. Coconut wax is a premium container wax with a creamy white finish, a slow burn, and excellent fragrance retention, the jasmine scent throw is noticeably stronger from coconut wax than from soy. Makes one 200 ml jar; burns for around 40 hours.
sourceNotes: Coconut wax candle characteristics: melt point 45-50°C; pour temperature 50-55°C (lower than soy). Fragrance load up to 10% of wax weight. Jasmine fragrance oil in coconut wax: excellent scent retention and good hot throw at 7-8% of wax weight. Coconut wax sets very slowly and at a lower temperature; allow 48 hours before burning. Wick sizing: slightly smaller wick than soy for the same jar diameter due to coconut wax's lower viscosity.

recipe.batchNotes: Scales directly. Coconut wax is the most expensive common candle wax; batch in larger quantities for best economy.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Coconut wax candles need 48 hours minimum before burning for full scent development and a firm set. A 4-day cure gives the best performance.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: Effectively indefinite. Coconut wax is very stable. Store away from heat sources as the low melt point means the wax can soften in a warm room.

glossaryTerms.definition: The temperature at which melted wax is poured into the container. Coconut wax pours at a lower temperature than soy, 50-55°C, because its melt point is lower.
The first burn of a new candle, long enough to melt the wax surface all the way to the jar edge. Coconut wax sets slowly and the memory burn may take 3-4 hours on a first light.

content.text: Coconut wax jasmine candle is a slow-burning, creamy-white jar candle with a full floral scent throw. Coconut wax holds fragrance better than soy at the same usage rate, giving a stronger, longer-lasting scent. It sets with a smooth, creamy white surface and burns cleanly without the frosting that sometimes appears on soy. One 200 ml jar; burns for around 40 hours.

content.text: Fix the wick in the jar. Melt coconut wax over a simmering-water bath to 60°C. Never leave unattended.
for coconut wax. Stir in the jasmine fragrance oil. Pour into the jar in a single slow pour.
Leave undisturbed for 48 hours. Do not move the candle during this period, coconut wax sets slowly and any disturbance shows as surface ripples.
